He repeated the same in April 2022 also, and induced her for sexual intercourse on the promise of marriage.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is a 19 year old boy, pursuing his Diploma in Musaliar College of Engineering.
He was having an affair with the victim girl, which was objected to by her mother.
So a false complaint was made against him to desist him from that relationship.
He was arrested on 3/12/2023, and he is in judicial custody since then.
He is ready to abide by any conditions imposed by this Court.
6. On instructions, learned Public Prosecutor submitted that investigation has progressed substantially.

In such circumstances, this Court is inclined to release him on bail on the following conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial court.

(ii) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer on alternate Saturdays starting from 24.02.2024 between 10.00 a.m and 11.00 a.m. for a period of three months, or till the final report is filed, whichever is earlier.

(iii) The petitioner shall not contact the victim or cause any kind of harassment to her or her family members, either directly or indirectly.
(iv) The petitioner shall not leave the limits of Kerala without prior permission of the trial court and he shall surrender his passport before the trial court within 15 days of executing the bond and if he is not having any passport, he he has to file affidavit to that effect before the trial court.
(v) The petitioner shall not commit any offence while on bail.
In case of violation of the bail conditions, the trial court is empowered to cancel the bail in accordance with law.

Sd/-
